annotations.title: KYC proof: hand the signature, get walletProof

description: Hand here the signature of kyc_proof_challenge with its nonce and message, unchanged. The challenge is consumed once and it returns { walletProof (vkp_..., 30 minutes, secret), wallet, expiresAt }. Pass walletProof to invoice_create or payout_batch when they ask for "crystal" (API: header X-Wallet-Proof). It proves possession only: without an approved KYC on that wallet the call still answers kyc_required (403). A challenge of another kind is refused with kyc_proof_challenge_invalid.

signature.description: EVM: the EIP-191 or EIP-712 signature. Solana: the ed25519 signature in base58.

transaction.description: Solana: the signed proofTransaction (base64), never sent.
